headline: South Korean Q3 GDP Growth Seen Accelerating on Semiconductor Shipments
summary: A Reuters poll showed South Korea's economic expansion likely gained momentum in the third quarter, driven by robust memory chip and semiconductor exports.
why: South Korea's export-driven economy serves as a critical leading indicator for global tech hardware and memory chip demand.

impacts.name: South Korea
impacts.why: Expanding memory chip exports bolster GDP growth and manufacturing output.

impacts.name: Semiconductors
impacts.why: Persistent external demand fuels revenue growth for South Korean chipmakers.
